children: According to Sina Finance, Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress promised employees pay raises and additional equity benefits in December at a companywide meeting on Wednesday, media reported, citing people familiar with the meeting. Nvidia will move the raises and new equity awards to December, breaking with its usual practice of conducting annual employee reviews in the spring.

title: Nvidia to Move Pay Raises and New Equity Awards Forward to December
